Name: Equinox Companion

Optional background submarine data and carried supplies require Journal V7.11.27. Pixel garden guide with local planting progress and fast paired updates requires Journal V7.11.28. Click-to-record command shortcuts in Settings. Requires Journal V7.11.18 for garden plans, care reminders and fertilizer sync. House Gardening links and growing/wilting/dead status sync require Journal V7.11.43. Submarine inventory-space and directly observed supply sync require Journal V7.11.52. English garden menus supported. In-game validation build.
Punchline: Your shared characters, estates, collections and timers.
